Step 1: Probability of first club = \(\frac{13}{52} = \frac{1}{4}\)
Step 2: After removing 1 club, remaining non-clubs = \(39\) of \(51\)
Step 3: Probability of second non-club = \(\frac{39}{51} = \frac{13}{17}\)
Step 4: Combined = \(\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{13}{17} = \frac{13}{68}\)
